basis: Every figure is a measurement of what has already happened, with the session or filing it came from. There is no forecast here, no score, and no list chosen by the publisher: a reader's own rule decides which companies appear and how many.
basis_ar: كل رقم هنا قياس لما حدث بالفعل، ومعه الجلسة أو الإفصاح الذي جاء منه. لا توجد توقعات ولا تقييمات ولا قائمة يختارها الناشر: قاعدة القارئ نفسه هي التي تحدد أي الشركات تظهر وكم عددها.

columns.ticker: The exchange's code for the company.
columns.sector: The sector the exchange files it under.
columns.as_of: The newest held trade session; quote date when no trade history exists.
columns.median_volume_20: Median volume of the previous 20 trade sessions — the denominator.
columns.median_traded_value_20: Median traded value of the previous 20 trade sessions, in pounds.
columns.relative_volume_20: Volume against that median. Undefined when the median is zero.
columns.change_1: Percentage change over 1 completed trade session.
columns.change_5: Percentage change over 5 completed trade sessions.
columns.change_20: Percentage change over 20 completed trade sessions.
columns.big_move_5: Trade sessions in the last 5 that moved at least 19.5% on the close.
columns.sessions_held: How many held trade sessions this row stands on: the company's archive, and the session that just closed once it is folded in.
columns.last_filing_date: Publication date of its newest filing.
columns.sessions_since_filing: Held trade sessions since that filing.
columns.filings_30d: Filings published in the last 30 days.
columns.last_filing_type: The classified type of that newest filing.
columns.last_filing_id: The exchange's id for it, so the row opens the source.
columns.market_cap: Market capitalisation, in pounds — a materiality denominator.
columns.revenue: Newest filed revenue, in millions of pounds.
columns.net_income: Newest filed net profit, in millions of pounds.
columns.net_income_growth: Against the same period a year earlier. Refused out of a loss.
columns.pe: Price over filed earnings per share.
columns.streak_break: A first loss after profits, or a first profit after losses.
columns.first_in_years: A filing type this company has not made in years.
columns.first_in_years_gap_days: How long since the previous one.
columns.quiet_days: Days silent, for a company that files often. Null when not unusual for it.
columns.results_due_from: Start of the window its results are expected in, from its own history.
columns.results_due_in_days: Days from this session to the start of that window. Negative once it has opened.
columns.missing: The columns this row could not compute, so a rule can say why.

breadth.what: Every listing in exactly one of five states. `level` traded and closed where it opened the day; `idle` found no buyer at all; `unmeasured` is a gap in what this project holds, not a quiet company. Folding the last two together would report a company nobody would buy as a company that held steady.
